title: Batch-wise Adaptive Pruning: Periodic Neuron Activation-Aware Weight Pruning for Language Reasoning Model
abstract: arXiv:2608.14003v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve strong performance on complex tasks through extended chain-of-thought generation, but incur substantial computational costs during inference. In production settings, batched inference is essential for high throughput, yet the existing training-free adaptive pruning methods we evaluate severely degrade in this regime. Because a batch must share a single pruning mask, these methods aggregate activations across samples and then apply threshold-based selection; the threshold, calibrated offline on unaggregated activations, no longer matches the aggregated distribution, so the realized sparsity ratio drifts and accuracy on reasoning tasks collapses under batched inference.   In this work, we propose a training-free adaptive pruning method designed specifically for batched inference in LRMs, built on two components. translated_title: 批量自适应剪枝：面向语言推理模型的周期性神经元激活感知权重剪枝
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14003v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大型推理模型（LRMs）通过扩展思维链生成在复杂任务上表现出色，但在推理过程中会产生大量计算成本。在生产环境中，批量推理对于高吞吐量至关重要，然而我们评估的现有免训练自适应剪枝方法在此场景下性能严重退化。由于一个批次必须共享单个剪枝掩码，这些方法跨样本聚合激活值并应用基于阈值的筛选；该阈值在未聚合的激活值上离线校准，不再匹配聚合后的分布，因此实际稀疏率漂移，导致在批量推理下推理任务的准确性崩溃。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种专门为LRMs中批量推理设计的免训练自适应剪枝方法，基于两个组成部分。首先，我们用周期性的top-k选择取代基于阈值的筛选，应用于聚合后的激活值。
tldr: 本文提出一种面向大型推理模型批量推理的免训练自适应剪枝方法，通过周期性top-k选择替代阈值筛选，解决了批量场景下稀疏率漂移和推理准确性崩溃的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a training-free adaptive pruning method for batched inference in large reasoning models, replacing threshold-based selection with periodic top-k selection to address sparsity drift and accuracy collapse under batch scenarios.
